newsitem.title: USA: Neoprobe seeks approval for cancer drug.
newsitem.headline: Neoprobe seeks approval for cancer drug.

text.p: Neoprobe Corp said on Monday that it has submitted a marketing application to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for its RIGScan CR49 drug for the intraoperative detection of metastatic colorectal cancer.
RIGScan CR49 is a monoclonal antibody that is used with the company's RIGS technology that combines cancer-specific targeting agencts, Neoprobe said.
This is the first product marketing application the company has filed with the FDA, Neoprobe said.
The product, which has been tested on more than 600 patients, is designed to find hidden tumor that cannot be found during a traditional surgery, Neoprobe said.
Neoprobe said it believes that product launch and commercial sale of the product may begin in 1997.
The company filed for marketing approval of the product in Europe in July, it said.
